jobs.snippet:

Location: Fargo

Department: AES Plant Path, Micro &Biotech

Position Information

The Department of Plant Pathology, Microbiology and Biotechnology, North Dakota State University, has available a postdoctoral research scientist position in the laboratory of Dr. Barney Geddes to work on rhizobia and plant-microbe symbiosis. The Geddes Lab studies the genetics, engineering, and ecology of nitrogen-fixing symbioses. jobs.title: Tenured: Professor and Department Head of Soil and Crop Sciences
jobs.snippet:
Description
The College of Agriculture and Life Sciences at Texas A&M University is seeking applications for a full-time, tenured Professor and Head of the Department of Soil and Crop Sciences. The expected start date is September 1, 2027, but is negotiable. This 9-month tenured position includes a majority administrative appointment with a 25% research appointment. The position comes with an administrative stipend equivalent to two months of summer salary, thus making this an 11-month appointment while the individual serves as Department Head. The research appointment is negotiable and can be fulfilled through a collaborative effort within the department, Texas A&M AgriLife Research, Texas A&M AgriLife Extension, or other institutional researchers. If desired, a teaching appointment is also negotiable. The role offers competitive university benefits, and additional support of a postdoctoral scientist available upon establishing a Hatch project.
